Organizing social sessions through messages felt unnecessarily difficult. Eventually, instead of only thinking about the problem, I started building VSB.

story.label: Coordination

interests.name: Formula 1
body: What interests me about Formula 1 is not only the racing.
It is how much of the sport can be understood through data: timing, tyres, strategy, telemetry, track position, and the constant search for small improvements.
That interest eventually became Sepang Vision Lab.

story.label: Interest
story.text: I like how Formula 1 uses data to understand performance. What interests me is not only the racing.

story.label: Questions
story.text: How much of the sport can be understood through data: timing, tyres, strategy, telemetry, track position, and the constant search for small improvements?

story.label: Data
story.text: A real race is a good place to test those questions. The 2017 Malaysian Grand Prix timing archive holds every recorded lap and pit stop.
